lines.en: I walk slowly along the street.
My cloak swings behind me.
I round the stalls and keep going.
My boots cross the flagstones.
I pause at the corner.
I walk up to the notice board.
I circle along the wall.
People on the road give me room.
I glance up at the sign.
I hitch the pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向下一个路口
lines.en: I head for the next corner.
I step aside for a cart.
I stand by the road and watch.
I gather my cloak about me.
I open the booklet in my hand.
I am noting the layout here.
I check the sky.
I close the booklet.
I stand with my hands down.
I let out a slow breath.
I am here if anyone needs directions.
I straighten my collar.
I lean on the pillar a moment.
I listen to the distant bell.
I roll my cuff back.
I look up at the eaves' pattern.
I rest a hand on my pouch.
I am waiting for word from above.
Are you asking directions or business?
I take in your clothing.
You are not from here.
If you have business, speak.
I move my hand off my pouch.
Your boots are caked with mud.

lines.zh: 我是从很远的地方来的
lines.en: I came from very far away.
I wave you nearer.
First let me hear you out.
Half the affairs here are mine.
Do not be nervous.
I am waiting for you to speak.
Something went wrong on the timeline.
I will remember your face.
I brace a hand on the wall.
That blow left me dazed.
The booklet slips from my hand.
A tear opens in my cloak.
Blood on my ledger; I wipe it away.
Blood runs into my eye.
I crouch to recover.

lines.zh: 我整了整被打歪的领口
lines.en: I fix my collar where it was hit.
I enter that one in my book.
I push myself upright.
I do not take such things.
Keep it for your own use.
I wave it off.
I look, then put it away.
That is not proper.
I smile politely.
I cannot take it for free.
I accept the thought.
I push the thing back to you.
I lack nothing here.
You bump me; I step aside.
I steady you before you fall.
I nearly drop my booklet.
Watch where you are going.
You stepped on my cloak.
I step back and settle.
This road is too narrow.
I gesture for you to pass.
A bump is nothing.
I brush off my sleeve.
She waits for me at the corner.
We patrol this street side by side.
She hands me the booklet.
I clear the crowd for her.
We read the same page.
She always speaks faster than I.
We look up at the clock together.
She straightens my cloak.

lines.zh: 我们在同一条街上值班
lines.en: We keep the same street.
She remembers what I forget.
I pick up a paper dropped on the road.
I tuck it into my booklet.
I pick up a coin.

lines.zh: 我把它交给旁边的孩子
lines.en: I hand it to the child nearby.
I pick up a snapped strap.
One look and I stow it.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原来的格子。
lines.en: I'll put it back in its slot.
I pick up a broken tile.
I set it by the wall.
I bend to pick up my booklet.
A fight breaks out at the corner.
I shut my booklet.
I throw my cloak back.
First I walk over to look.
This street is mine.
I dislike fighting here.
I stuff the booklet inside my coat.
Someone called my name.
I step into the middle of the street.
Everyone stop first.
I raise one hand.
The bystanders back away.
I close in with measured steps.
I watch how they stand.
Nothing may go wrong here.
I settle my weight low.
I track where each of them is.
I wait for an opening.
Half a step in is enough.
First I block the crossing.
I call out for them to hold.
They have raised their weapons.
I would still give them a chance.
I fix on the one in front.
Ki gathers at my feet.
My palm strikes his chest.
I turn his blade with my arm.
I pin him against the wall.
I kick his weapon away.
That one was only a warning.
I slip aside and answer.
I seize his wrist and twist.
He retreats; I do not chase.
I push him off with a knee.
I throw him to the ground.
I step out from the corner.
I shake out my cloak.
I look along the street first.
I stop before the notice board.
I open the booklet to a page.
People on the road turn to look.
This place is quiet enough.
I note the location.
I tie my pouch shut.
I raise a hand to greet the passers-by.

lines.zh: 我从传送的余光里走出
lines.en: I step out of the afterglow of travel.
I settle and look all around.
This street is mine to patrol.
I hear noise in the distance.

lines.zh: 火燎着了我斗篷的下摆
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak's hem.
I fall from the eaves.
Water chokes my throat.
The blast blows my booklet away.
An arrowhead sinks into my shoulder.
Spell light burns through my cuff.
Hunger makes me unsteady.
Lightning hits the lamp post beside me.
The street breaks away under me.
